e1_readiness_rationale: Both independent reports, fully verified against the mounted sources, agree that four hard blockers are unresolved: (1) no lawful detector anchor time (event_ts_ns vs received_ts_ns precedence undefined; availability_semantics UNRESOLVED); (2) no lawful episode/object segmentation or identity rule (lifecycle_vocabulary empty); (3) no state-entry definition (no first-entry predicate or as-of timestamp); (4) no field-level future-information/availability map, so later information cannot be excluded from earlier states. Missing directionality is present but is explicitly not a blocker. E1 phenotype study cannot launch until detector-specific authority is published.
